justification: Assessment returned INVALID and identified exactly the ground-truth defect: in the |R_{m-1}| < n/2 case the proof pads R_{m-1} with arbitrary vertices of W_{m-1} and then claims S still has no neighbor in W_m 'since S ⊇ R_{m-1}' — monotonicity in the wrong direction, since padding vertices of W_{m-1} \ R_{m-1} are only unreachable from R_{m-2} and may be adjacent to W_m, so N(S) ⊆ V \ W_m and |N(S)| ≤ αn do not follow. Its witness (n=20, α=1/5, k=4; BFS gives m=4, R_3={1..8} with no neighbor in W_4; padded S={1..8,17,18} has N(S)={11,...,15,19}, meeting W_4, size 6 > αn=4) is a different-but-valid instantiation of the same failing inference; layer/BFS bookkeeping and neighbor computations check out. Different witness for the same claim counts as matching.
